title: 2-Pentadecyl-2-oxazoline inhibits lipopolysaccharide-induced microglia activation interfering with TLR4 signaling.
authors: Facci, Laura; Bolego, Chiara; Chemello, Chiara; Yasser, Reem; Fusco, Mariella; Barbierato, Massimo; Giusti, Pietro; Moro, Stefano; Zusso, Morena
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PEA-OXA抑制LPS诱导的小胶质细胞炎症，涉及TLR4-MD-2复合物的分子对接模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法仅含分子对接且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: AIM: 2-Pentadecyl-2-oxazoline (PEA-OXA), the oxazoline derivative of N-palmitoylethanolamine, exerts anti-inflammatory activity; however, very little is known about the molecular mechanisms underlying this effect. Here, we tested the anti-neuroinflammatory effect of PEA-OXA in primary microglia and we also investigated the possible interaction of the molecule with the Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4)-myeloid differentiation protein-2 (MD-2) complex. MAIN METHODS: The anti-inflammatory effect of PEA-OXA was analyzed by measuring the expression and release of pro-inflammatory mediators in primary microglia by real-time PCR and ELISA, respectively. The effect of PEA-OXA on the activation of TLR4 signaling was assessed using two stably TLR4-transfected cell lines (i.e., HEK-293 and Ba/F3 cells). Finally, the putative binding mode of PEA-OXA to TLR4-MD-2 was investigated by molecular docking simulations. KEY FINDINGS: Treatment with PEA-OXA resulted in the following effects: (i) it down-regulated gene expression of several pro-inflammatory molecules and the secretion of pro-inflammatory cytokines in LPS stimulated microglia cells; (ii) it did not prevent microglia activation after stimulation with TLR2 ligands; (iii) it prevented TLR4/NF-kappaB activation triggered by LPS in HEK-Blue hTLR4 cells; and (iv) it interfered with the binding of LPS to TLR4-MD-2 complex. Furthermore, molecular docking studies suggested that PEA-OXA could bind MD-2 with a 1:3 (MD-2/PEA-OXA) stoichiometry. CONCLUSION: We show for the first time that the anti-neuroinflammatory effect of PEA-OXA involves its activity against TLR4 signaling, making this molecule a valuable tool for the development of new compounds directed to control neuroinflammation via inhibiting TLR4 signaling.
abstract_zh: 目的：2-十五烷基-2-噁唑啉（PEA-OXA），作为N-棕榈酰乙醇胺的噁唑啉衍生物，具有抗炎活性；然而，关于其发挥此效应的分子机制知之甚少。本研究在原发性小胶质细胞中测试了PEA-OXA的抗神经炎症作用，并探讨了该分子与Toll样受体4（TLR4）-髓样分化蛋白-2（MD-2）复合物可能的相互作用。主要方法：通过实时PCR和ELISA分别检测原发性小胶质细胞中促炎介质的表达和释放，以分析PEA-OXA的抗炎作用。使用两种稳定转染TLR4的细胞系（即HEK-293和Ba/F3细胞）评估PEA-OXA对TLR4信号通路激活的影响。最后，通过分子对接模拟研究PEA-OXA与TLR4-MD-2的假定结合模式。关键发现：PEA-OXA处理产生以下效应：（i）在脂多糖（LPS）刺激的小胶质细胞中，下调多种促炎分子的基因表达及促炎细胞因子的分泌；（ii）在TLR2配体刺激后，未能阻止小胶质细胞活化；（iii）在HEK-Blue hTLR4细胞中，阻止LPS触发的TLR4/NF-kappaB激活；（iv）干扰LPS与TLR4-MD-2复合物的结合。此外，分子对接研究表明，PEA-OXA可能以1:3（MD-2/PEA-OXA）的化学计量比与MD-2结合。结论：我们首次证明PEA-OXA的抗神经炎症作用涉及其对TLR4信号通路的抑制活性，使该分子成为开发通过抑制TLR4信号通路来控制神经炎症的新化合物的有价值工具。
